materials.summary_zh: 原本计划去海边，结果下雨了。一家人在家度过了意外愉快的一天。（虚构故事）

segments.en: Last Saturday, my family planned a trip to the beach.
segments.zh: 上周六，我们一家计划去海边玩。

segments.en: We packed sandwiches, towels and a big umbrella.
segments.zh: 我们带好了三明治、毛巾和一把大伞。

segments.en: But when we woke up, it was raining heavily.
segments.zh: 可是我们醒来时，外面正下着大雨。

segments.en: My little brother was very disappointed, and he started to cry.
segments.zh: 我弟弟非常失望，哭了起来。

segments.en: So my mum had an idea.
segments.zh: 于是妈妈想了个主意。

segments.en: We moved the sofa, put the towels on the floor and had a picnic in the living room.
segments.zh: 我们挪开沙发，把毛巾铺在地上，在客厅里野餐。

segments.en: After lunch, we played board games and watched an old film together.
segments.zh: 午饭后，我们一起玩桌游，看了一部老电影。

segments.en: In the evening, the rain stopped and we saw a rainbow over the houses.
segments.zh: 傍晚雨停了，我们看到房子上空出现了一道彩虹。

segments.en: My brother said it was the best beach day ever, even without the beach.
segments.zh: 弟弟说这是他过得最好的“海边日”，虽然根本没去海边。

glossary.zh: 打包；装好（pack 的过去式）
醒来（wake up 的过去式）

glossary.note_zh: the best ... ever = 有史以来最好的

questions.prompt_zh: 一家人原本计划去哪里？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：my family planned a trip to the beach.

questions.prompt_zh: 他们为什么没去成？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：it was raining heavily.

questions.prompt_zh: 他们在哪里野餐？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：had a picnic in the living room.

questions.prompt_zh: 弟弟最后觉得这一天怎么样？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：it was the best beach day ever.

materials.title_zh: 通知：山坡图书馆的变化
materials.summary_zh: 一家社区图书馆贴出的通知：开放时间、新服务和注意事项。（虚构的通知）

segments.en: From 1 March, Hillside Library will have new opening hours.
segments.zh: 从 3 月 1 日起，山坡图书馆将实行新的开放时间。

segments.en: We will open at 9 am and close at 7 pm from Monday to Friday.
segments.zh: 周一至周五，上午 9 点开门，晚上 7 点关门。

segments.en: On Saturdays, we will close earlier, at 4 pm.
segments.zh: 周六会提前在下午 4 点关门。

segments.en: The library will be closed on Sundays.
segments.zh: 周日闭馆。

segments.en: There is also some good news: you can now borrow up to ten books at a time.
segments.zh: 还有一个好消息：现在每次最多可以借十本书。

segments.en: You can keep them for three weeks.
segments.zh: 可以借三周。

segments.en: Our new study room on the first floor is free for all members.
segments.zh: 二楼新开的自习室对所有会员免费开放。

segments.en: Please book a table at the front desk before you use it.
segments.zh: 使用前请在前台预约座位。

segments.en: Please remember that food is not allowed in the reading areas.
segments.zh: 请记住，阅读区内禁止饮食。

segments.en: If you have any questions, please ask our staff.
segments.zh: 如有任何问题，请咨询工作人员。

glossary.note_zh: 英式英语 ground floor 是一楼，first floor 是二楼。

questions.prompt_zh: 周六图书馆几点关门？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：On Saturdays, we will close earlier, at 4 pm.

questions.prompt_zh: 现在每次最多能借几本书？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：borrow up to ten books at a time.

questions.prompt_zh: 使用自习室之前要做什么？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：Please book a table at the front desk before you use it.

questions.prompt_zh: 哪一项在阅读区是不允许的？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：food is not allowed in the reading areas.

materials.summary_zh: 两个同事聊周末打算做什么，并约好一起去看展。

segments.speaker: Mark
segments.en: Have you got any plans for the weekend, Jenny?
segments.zh: 珍妮，你周末有什么安排吗？

segments.speaker: Jenny
segments.en: Yes, I'm going to visit my grandparents on Saturday.
segments.zh: 有，我周六要去看我的祖父母。

segments.speaker: Jenny
segments.en: They live in a village about an hour from here.
segments.zh: 他们住在离这儿大约一小时车程的村子里。

segments.speaker: Mark
segments.en: That sounds nice. Are you going by train?
segments.zh: 听起来不错。你坐火车去吗？

segments.speaker: Jenny
segments.en: No, I'm going to drive. What about you?
segments.zh: 不，我开车去。你呢？

segments.speaker: Mark
segments.en: I'm not sure yet. I might go to the new photo exhibition on Sunday.
segments.zh: 我还没定。周日可能去看那个新开的摄影展。

segments.speaker: Jenny
segments.en: Oh, I want to see that too! Is it expensive?
segments.zh: 哦，我也想去！贵吗？

segments.speaker: Mark
segments.en: No, it's free on Sundays.
segments.zh: 不贵，周日免费。

segments.speaker: Jenny
segments.en: Shall we go together? I'll be back by Sunday morning.
segments.zh: 我们一起去吧？我周日上午就回来了。

segments.speaker: Mark
segments.en: Great idea. Let's meet outside the museum at two o'clock.
segments.zh: 好主意。我们两点在博物馆门口见吧。

glossary.note_zh: be going to + 动词原形：表示已经打算好的事。

questions.prompt_zh: 珍妮周六要做什么？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：I'm going to visit my grandparents on Saturday.

questions.prompt_zh: 她怎么去？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：No, I'm going to drive.

questions.prompt_zh: 周日的摄影展票价是？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：it's free on Sundays.

questions.prompt_zh: 他们约在哪里见面？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：Let's meet outside the museum at two o'clock.

materials.summary_zh: 一位乘客在火车上丢了手机，到车站的失物招领处询问。

segments.speaker: Clerk
segments.en: Good afternoon. How can I help you?
segments.zh: 下午好。有什么可以帮您？

segments.speaker: Passenger
segments.en: Hi. I think I left my phone on the train this morning.
segments.zh: 你好。我好像今天早上把手机落在火车上了。

segments.speaker: Clerk
segments.en: I'm sorry to hear that. Which train were you on?
segments.zh: 很遗憾。您坐的是哪一班车？

segments.speaker: Passenger
segments.en: The 8:15 from Bridgeton. I got off here at nine.
segments.zh: 布里奇顿发车的 8 点 15 分那班。我九点在这儿下的车。

segments.speaker: Clerk
segments.en: What does your phone look like?
segments.zh: 您的手机是什么样子的？

segments.speaker: Passenger
segments.en: It's black, and it has a green case with a small star on the back.
segments.zh: 黑色的，套着绿色手机壳，背面有一颗小星星。

segments.speaker: Clerk
segments.en: Let me check. Someone brought in two phones today.
segments.zh: 我查一下。今天有人送来两部手机。

segments.speaker: Clerk
segments.en: Is this one yours?
segments.zh: 这部是您的吗？

segments.speaker: Passenger
segments.en: Yes, that's it! Thank you so much.
segments.zh: 对，就是它！太感谢了。

segments.speaker: Clerk
segments.en: You're welcome. Can you sign this form, please?
segments.zh: 不客气。请您在这张表上签个字。

glossary.zh: 落下；遗留（leave 的过去式）
下车（get off 的过去式）

glossary.note_zh: What does it look like? = 它是什么样子的？

glossary.zh: 送来；拿进来（bring in 的过去式）

questions.prompt_zh: 乘客把手机落在哪里了？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：I left my phone on the train this morning.

questions.prompt_zh: 手机壳是什么颜色的？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：It's black, and it has a green case. 手机是黑色，手机壳是绿色。

questions.prompt_zh: 最后工作人员请乘客做什么？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：Can you sign this form, please?

materials.summary_zh: 作者回忆十六岁在海边咖啡馆打工的暑假：一开始错误百出，后来学会了很多。

segments.en: When I was sixteen, I got my first job in a small café near the beach.
segments.zh: 我十六岁时，在海边一家小咖啡馆找到了第一份工作。

segments.en: I worked there every Saturday and Sunday during the summer holidays.
segments.zh: 暑假期间，我每周六和周日都在那里工作。

segments.en: At first, everything was difficult.
segments.zh: 一开始，一切都很难。

segments.en: I dropped plates, forgot orders and gave people the wrong change.
segments.zh: 我打碎过盘子，忘记过点单，还找错过零钱。

segments.en: One day I spilled a whole glass of orange juice on a customer.
segments.zh: 有一天我把一整杯橙汁洒在了一位顾客身上。

segments.en: I wanted to go home and never come back.
segments.zh: 我真想回家再也不来了。

segments.en: But the owner, Mrs Lane, was very kind.
segments.zh: 但是老板莱恩太太人很好。

segments.en: She told me that everybody makes mistakes when they start.
segments.zh: 她告诉我，每个人刚开始都会犯错。

segments.en: By the end of the summer, I could carry four plates at once.
segments.zh: 到暑假结束时，我能一次端四个盘子了。

segments.en: I also learned how to talk to strangers and stay calm when the café was busy.
segments.zh: 我还学会了怎么和陌生人说话，以及在咖啡馆很忙的时候保持冷静。

questions.prompt_zh: 作者什么时候在咖啡馆工作？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：every Saturday and Sunday during the summer holidays.

questions.prompt_zh: 作者一开始遇到了什么问题？
options: 经常出错，比如打碎盘子、找错零钱
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：I dropped plates, forgot orders and gave people the wrong change.

questions.prompt_zh: 老板莱恩太太说了什么？
options: 每个人刚开始都会犯错
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：everybody makes mistakes when they start.

questions.prompt_zh: 到暑假结束时，作者能做到什么？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：By the end of the summer, I could carry four plates at once.

materials.summary_zh: 游泳馆的告示：游泳前要做什么、哪些事不允许、储物柜怎么用、什么时候只对成人开放。

segments.en: Greenfield Swimming Pool: please read before you swim
segments.zh: 绿野游泳馆：游泳前请阅读

segments.en: Please take a shower before you go into the pool.
segments.zh: 进入泳池前请先淋浴。

segments.en: Children under eight must swim with an adult at all times.
segments.zh: 八岁以下儿童游泳时必须始终有成人陪同。

segments.en: Don't run near the pool, because the floor is often wet.
segments.zh: 不要在泳池边奔跑，因为地面经常是湿的。

segments.en: Food and drinks are not allowed in the pool area.
segments.zh: 泳池区域不允许带食物和饮料。

segments.en: You can use the lockers for free.
segments.zh: 储物柜免费使用。

segments.en: You need a one-pound coin, but you get it back later.
segments.zh: 需要一枚一英镑硬币，但之后会退还。

segments.en: From Monday to Friday, the pool is for adults only from six to eight in the morning.
segments.zh: 周一到周五早上六点到八点，泳池只对成人开放。

segments.en: Swimming lessons for children are on Saturday mornings.
segments.zh: 儿童游泳课在周六上午。

segments.en: If you need help, please ask a lifeguard.
segments.zh: 需要帮助请找救生员。

segments.en: We hope you enjoy your swim!
segments.zh: 祝你游得愉快！

questions.prompt_zh: 几岁以下的孩子必须有成人陪同？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：Children under eight must swim with an adult at all times.

questions.prompt_zh: 为什么不能在泳池边跑？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：because the floor is often wet.

questions.prompt_zh: 关于储物柜，哪一项是对的？
options: 免费，但要放一枚一英镑硬币，之后会退还
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：You can use the lockers for free. You need a one-pound coin, but you get it back later.

questions.prompt_zh: 工作日早上六点到八点谁可以游泳？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：the pool is for adults only from six to eight in the morning.

materials.summary_zh: 家里的猫胡椒不见了，主人到处寻找，两天后接到一个电话。（虚构故事）

segments.en: Pepper is our black and white cat, and she usually sleeps on the sofa all day.
segments.zh: 胡椒是我们家的黑白猫，她平时整天睡在沙发上。

segments.en: But last Monday, when I came home from work, she wasn't there.
segments.zh: 但是上周一我下班回家时，她不在那儿。

segments.en: I looked under the beds, in the garden and behind the fridge.
segments.zh: 我找了床底下、花园里和冰箱后面。

segments.en: Then I walked around the streets and called her name, but she didn't come.
segments.zh: 然后我在附近的街上转，喊她的名字，但她没出来。

segments.en: That night, I made posters with her photo and put them on trees.
segments.zh: 那天晚上，我做了带她照片的寻猫启事，贴在树上。

segments.en: Two days later, an old man from the next street phoned me.
segments.zh: 两天后，隔壁街的一位老人给我打电话。

segments.en: He said a cat was sleeping in his garage.
segments.zh: 他说有只猫睡在他的车库里。

segments.en: I ran there as fast as I could.
segments.zh: 我拼命跑了过去。

segments.en: It was Pepper! She was hungry but fine.
segments.zh: 是胡椒！她饿了，但没事。

segments.en: Now Pepper has a collar with our phone number on it, just in case.
segments.zh: 现在胡椒戴着一个写有我们电话号码的项圈，以防万一。

questions.prompt_zh: 胡椒平时白天做什么？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：she usually sleeps on the sofa all day.

questions.prompt_zh: 作者找猫时做了什么？
options: 做了寻猫启事贴在树上
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：I made posters with her photo and put them on trees.

questions.prompt_zh: 胡椒在哪里被找到？
options: 隔壁街一位老人的车库里
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：an old man from the next street … a cat was sleeping in his garage.

questions.prompt_zh: 现在胡椒戴着什么？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：Now Pepper has a collar with our phone number on it.

materials.summary_zh: 一篇博客：作者和朋友去上泰国菜烹饪课，做了绿咖喱和芒果甜点。

segments.en: Last Saturday, my friend Ben and I went to a Thai cooking class in the city centre.
segments.zh: 上周六，我和朋友本去市中心上了一节泰国菜烹饪课。

segments.en: There were eight people in the class, and our teacher was a chef called Nok.
segments.zh: 班上有八个人，我们的老师是一位叫诺克的厨师。

segments.en: First, she showed us how to make green curry.
segments.zh: 首先，她教我们做绿咖喱。

segments.en: We cut vegetables, crushed garlic and mixed the sauce ourselves.
segments.zh: 我们自己切菜、捣蒜、调酱汁。

segments.en: My curry was too spicy, so Nok added some coconut milk.
segments.zh: 我的咖喱太辣了，所以诺克加了些椰奶。

segments.en: After that, we made a simple mango dessert.
segments.zh: 之后，我们做了一道简单的芒果甜点。

segments.en: At the end, we all sat at a long table and ate what we cooked.
segments.zh: 最后，我们都坐在一张长桌旁，吃自己做的菜。

segments.en: The class cost forty pounds, and it lasted three hours.
segments.zh: 这节课四十英镑，持续了三个小时。

segments.en: It wasn't cheap, but I learned a lot and had a great time.
segments.zh: 不算便宜，但我学到了很多，玩得也很开心。

segments.en: I'm going to cook green curry for my parents this weekend!
segments.zh: 这个周末我要给爸妈做绿咖喱！

questions.prompt_zh: 老师是谁？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：our teacher was a chef called Nok.

questions.prompt_zh: 作者的咖喱有什么问题？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：My curry was too spicy.

questions.prompt_zh: 这节课多少钱、多长时间？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：The class cost forty pounds, and it lasted three hours.

questions.prompt_zh: 作者这个周末打算做什么？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：I'm going to cook green curry for my parents this weekend!
